title: Recordkeeping Completeness Mapper
description: Channel inventory roll-up for books-and-records completeness over caller-declared synthetic inputs. Declares each channel (email, chat, voice, messaging, ...) with a captured flag and a retrieval-test result (pass/fail/not_run), and computes: total, captured count, completeness percentage (whole number, half-up), the uncaptured listing, retrieval-pass count, and an overall verdict (COMPLETE only when every channel is captured AND every retrieval test passes; otherwise GAPS_FOUND). Not-proven discipline: it does not check live SSR tapes, borrow lists, cutoff feeds, registers, or any records system -- a COMPLETE verdict is the caller's declaration, never an attestation. Absent or invalid inputs fail closed and are named. No network, no storage, no clock.

captured.description: Caller-declared capture status; the tool never verifies against a records system.

retrieval_test.description: Caller-declared retrieval-test result; not_run is treated as a gap.

total.description: Declared channel count; null on the fail-closed path.

completeness_pct.description: Whole-number percentage, half-up rounded, of captured/total.

uncaptured.description: Names of channels declared not captured.

retrieval_passes.description: Count of channels whose declared retrieval_test is pass.

overall.description: COMPLETE iff every channel captured and every retrieval test pass; otherwise GAPS_FOUND.

trace.description: Fail-closed reasons naming each rejected input (fail-closed path only).

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_recordkeeping_completeness_mapper
mcp_tool_definition.description: Rolls up a caller-declared books-and-records channel inventory: total, captured count, completeness percentage, uncaptured names, retrieval-pass count, and an overall COMPLETE/GAPS_FOUND verdict. Arithmetic of declared inputs only -- does not check live records systems; not_run retrieval tests are gaps, never assumed passes. Invalid inputs fail closed and are named.
